title: Villa 2 - Oceanview Rooftop / 2-min Walk to Beach!
description: Welcome to the newly renovated La Casa Greub, ocean-view rooftop, and 2 min from the beach!Private dinner on the terrace? Rooftop BBQ with friends? We’ve spared no expense to make every inch of this property an amazing spot to relax or socialize with family and friends. This is an air conditioned Villa at La Casa Greub, which can accommodate 4 guests. This villa is on the second floor with a private dining area and access to multiple shared dining/lounging areas.The space2 Minute Walk To The Beach | Newly Renovated | 2 Bedrooms | 4 Guests | Kitchen (Stove and Microwave) | Private Deck for Lounging/Dinning | Shared Access To Second Floor Lounge and Rooftop Deck (The Tree House)This villa is located on the second level of La Casa Greub in Stella Rincón, PR. This villa has access to a shared rooftop deck (partially covered) that has a beautiful view of the ocean, mountains, and local vegetation. There is also a shared lounge area on the second floor with a great vibe and multiple places to hang out and relax. This villa is within an easy 2 minute walk to the beach.This villa can accommodate up to 4 guests in two different bedrooms. One bedroom has a queen sized bed and the other bedroom has a bunk-bed (twin mattress over full mattress). Each room of the villa has its own air conditioning, heating, ceiling fan, clothing storage, and lamp. There is also a spacious open living/kitchen area with a large sectional and TV. The two bedrooms share a complete bathroom with a walk-in shower. La Casa Greub consists of 4 separate villas, all of which can be booked separately or in combination.Guest accessYou will have private access to your bedrooms, bathroom, and open living/kitchen area. You will also have private access to a patio just outside your door for outdoor dinning/lounging. There is also plenty of parking on both sides of the property. Other guests of La Casa Greub have access to the second-floor lounge and the rooftop deck. Be sure to visit the beautiful rooftop created for socializing, relaxing, and enjoying the beautiful view of the ocean and mountains. The rooftop has two twin sized swings, picnic table, BBQ Grill, refrigerator, sink, bathroom, outdoor furniture, and lounge chairs. There is also an outdoor shower located on the ground level to wash off after visiting the beach.There is two different beaches located within a 2 minute walk of the property, no need to drive there.Other things to noteEach villa is accommodated with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, coffee maker, blender, dishes, utensils, soap, and ice trays. We have pots and pans in each Villa but no oil, salt, or pepper.You will have access to a washer and dryer located on the second floor, which is also shared with other guests. We have a Graco Pack’n Play crib available upon request.
amenities: Pack ’n play/Travel crib - available upon request

description: 3BR/2 bath - sleeps 6 - Upper floor of house a 3 minute walk to Steps Beach or Marina. Great for couples or families - bring the kids! Rent the other floor, which is identical, if you want 12 to stay. Your biggest problem will be deciding whether to snorkel, body surf, or go whale watching or diving. Relax on the private balcony. Enjoy fresh seafood at a waterfront restaurant or grill on the rooftop deck. We have everything you need for a great day in the sun - beach chairs, towels and coolers.The spaceUPSTAIRS UNIT - sleeps 6(The entire house sleeps 12, 6 on each level. This listing is for the upstairs unit, you can also rent the downstairs unit. There are separate entrances, so it's ideal for small groups or extended family. Both units have access to the rooftop deck.) Stroll back from snorkeling at the Tres Palmas Marine Preserve, rinse the sand off your toes in our outdoor shower, and relax in the cool, ocean breezes while you barbecue on our beautiful, tiled rooftop deck. Enjoy morning coffee on the 2nd floor balcony. We provide a fully equipped kitchen and living area with A/C in all rooms, WiFi, and Smart TV. The master bedroom has a queen bed and an en suite bathroom. You can have each of the other 2 bedrooms made up with twin beds or with a king.Our location makes everything easy. Beaches abound, and we have everything you need for a great day in the sun - beach chairs, towels, and coolers. Rincon is the surf capitol of the Caribbean. We are 5 minutes from surfing beaches where you can rent a board and take a lesson. Or walk down the block and snorkel, float, or try a stand up paddle board on the marina's calm waters. If dry land activities are more your speed, our location gives you easy access to pickleball courts that have regular pickup games, running trails in the woods by Domes Beach, and horseback riding tours.Walk to the beach at the end of the block to enjoy a fabulous sunset. Or you can enter the Paseo Comunitario walking trail that goes past several beaches and ends at the clifftop Punta Higuera lighthouse park. The park has a lively atmosphere for the beautiful sunsets and you might spot a whale! The plaza in the center of town is 1 mile from the house and every Thursday night holds the Art Walk, a festival with music, food, and unique items handcrafted by local artisans. You'll also find the farmers market there every Sunday morning for tasty local produce.Your biggest problem will be to decide whether to snorkel, surf, or walk around the corner to the marina and take a whale watching or diving trip. You can have a pleasant evening in with our many books and games, listening to the song of the coquis, the native Puerto Rican tree frogs. Or walk over to one of the many waterfront restaurants to experience fresh seafood and other local delights. Bring a desire to relax and have fun - we supply everything else!Rincon is known as the “Town of Beautiful Sunsets”. It is a relaxing, tropical paradise on the west coast of Puerto Rico. Rincon’s unique location lets you enjoy the tranquil Caribbean, as well as the waves of the Atlantic. And our unique location lets you enjoy the best of Rincon. There is something for everyone - bars and restaurants, horseback riding, watersports galore, and easy access to local attractions like waterfalls and the famed Camuy Caverns.Rincon has it all, and Casa Tranquila puts it all at your fingertips. Come once and enjoy our hospitality and we bet you'll become one of our many repeat visitors who come back year after year.Guest accessThe entire house sleeps 12, 6 on each level; rent 1 or both. There are separate entrances, so it's ideal for small groups or extended family. You can have togetherness, and still have your own space. Whether you take both levels or 1, you will also be able to enjoy the rooftop terrace, the grill and all the beach equipment, and the outside shower at the end of the day.Other things to noteQuiet, residential neighborhood, a short walk from the beach and a number of restaurants. A large grocery store is 1 mile away and there's also various small bakeries and shops. A 5 minute drive will get you to the beaches on the Atlantic side and other bars and restaurants.

title: Paradise in Rincón, walking distance to the beach
description: Paddle Villa is a three-bedroom, two-bathroom townhouse. Perfect for family vacations or a surfing escapade. It's ambiance, decor, and character truly define the Rincon lifestyle. If you are looking to relax, experience breathtaking sunsets, and panoramic views and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer then this is the place for you! Just a short walk away from the beach where you can experience calm waters in the Summer and world-class surfing during the Winter season.The spaceLIVING AREA AND KITCHEN:You will love Paddle Villa’s open concept layout with a grand room that includes the family room, dining room and kitchen without walls or division. There is an 8 person dining table, comfortable sofa with large flat screen TV with cable and high speed internet, and a fully equipped kitchen with a bar countertop with 2 stools. BEDROOMSThe master bedroom has a king bed, flat screen smart TV, and dedicated bathroom. The second bedroom has 2 twin beds with 2 twin trundle beds underneath and a flat screen smart TV. The 3rd bedroom has full size murphy bed and surfboard storage. LOCATION:There are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:- Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. - Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.- Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.- Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.- Watch an afternoon sunset at Sandy Beach or Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.- Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards. Guests can rent surfing boards at The Beach House. GETTING AROUND:Renting a car is a must when staying at Paddle Villa. There are no taxis or Ubers

title: Calala House
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.The spaceEnjoy a relaxing stay in this cozy home for up to 4 guests in Rincon. Located in a peaceful area, this home is the perfect base to explore Rincon famous beaches, surf spots, local restaurants and breathtaking sunsets. The home features 2 bedrooms and 1 private bathroom with hot water. The primary bedroom includes a king-size bed; the second bedroom has a full-size bed. Guests can unwind in the comfortable living room or prepare meal in the fully equipped kitchen.Guest accessCheck-in time is 3:00pm. The house has a lockbox with the keys inside, so after the official check-in time you may arrive at any time. On the day of your check-in you will receive all the information through the Airbnb inbox. Parking is available on the property.Other things to noteWe do not have a power generator in case of a power outage. Taxi service in Rincon is very limited, so renting a car is the best option to fully enjoy the area.
